name: WooCommerce
description: WooCommerce is an open-source commerce platform built for WordPress websites. Store owners use it to manage products, orders, customers, payments, shipping, taxes, promotions, and extensions while retaining control of their hosting and data.
agentUseSummary: Connect one exact public HTTPS WooCommerce store with a dedicated read/write REST API key, then let agents inspect bounded products and categories, prepare product changes, create or update drafts, and publish an explicitly reviewed draft under Safe or Dangerous policy. Relay encrypts both consumer credentials, checks the store boundary before every request, and does not expose orders, customers, payments, refunds, inventory writes, coupons, webhooks, settings, reports, destructive operations, automatic pagination, or arbitrary REST access in V1.

credentialRequirements.name: WOOCOMMERCE_STORE_ORIGIN
credentialRequirements.label: Store address
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the exact public HTTPS origin of the WordPress store, such as https://shop.example.com, without a path.

credentialRequirements.name: WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Consumer key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Generate a dedicated read/write key through WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API or WooCommerce Application Authentication.

credentialRequirements.name: WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Consumer secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the matching consumer secret. Relay encrypts it and never exposes it to agents or clients after saving.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded reads and local preparation run directly; draft creation, draft updates, and publication require matching approval.

providerSetup.nextAction: A store administrator enters the exact HTTPS store address and either uses WooCommerce Application Authentication or creates a dedicated read/write REST API key under WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API. Relay then verifies the store, bounded reads, Safe approval binding, Dangerous draft creation and update, explicit publication, key revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in staging.

evidence.supports: WooCommerce REST API v3 is the current recommended integration and supports JSON create, read, update, and delete operations for store resources through WordPress REST routes.

WooCommerce REST keys are generated for a WordPress user with read, write, or read/write access; Application Authentication uses /wc-auth/v1/authorize and posts the generated consumer key and secret to an HTTPS callback.
HTTPS REST requests authenticate with HTTP Basic authentication using the consumer key and consumer secret; Relay deliberately does not use the documented query-string fallback.
Collection routes use bounded page and per_page parameters and return X-WP-Total and X-WP-TotalPages metadata.
The authenticated WooCommerce REST API covers business resources including orders, products, coupons, customers, and shipping zones; Relay's V1 intentionally exposes only the bounded product subset.
